turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Sit down, Hale. Owen says you gave him a zero and he found out from his phone, in the middle of class, before anyone called me. I have about twenty minutes, so tell me why.
Don't thank me yet. You haven't answered the question. Why did Owen find out from his phone before you called me?
Answer in exactly one word. Should the zero come off?
I'm not answering a yes-or-no question about the mark until you tell me why I heard about it from my son's phone.
One word. Is Owen telling the truth?
I'm not giving you one word on my son. You haven't told me what you have, so tell me.
